# Pick Your Row

> Pick Your Row (pickyourrow.com) publishes original, illustrative airline seat maps and editorial best seat picks for 188 typical cabin configurations across 56 airlines and 33 aircraft types, plus 43 evergreen guides on choosing a seat. The maps are drawn from publicly known typical cabin facts, are not scraped from airlines or other seat map sites, and can differ from the aircraft on a given flight, so always confirm seats with the airline. Pick Your Row is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any airline.

Operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC.

Seat scores and picks are editorial opinions for planning, not guarantees and not airline advice. Interiors vary by aircraft registration and retrofit.

## Start here

- [Home](https://pickyourrow.com/): Overview of the site with links to airline seat maps, aircraft types, best seats and guides.
- [Airlines directory](https://pickyourrow.com/airlines/): Seat maps grouped by carrier for all 56 airlines covered.
- [Aircraft types](https://pickyourrow.com/aircraft/): Seat maps and seating plans grouped by aircraft type, comparing airline layouts for 33 types.
- [Best seats directory](https://pickyourrow.com/best-seats/): Editorial best seat shortlists for all 188 illustrated cabin configurations.
- [Guides](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/): Index of evergreen seat selection guides with cited sources.
- [Methodology and sources](https://pickyourrow.com/methodology/): How the schematics and editorial seat scores are made, with citations to FAA, DOT, EU, IATA, ICAO and other public sources.

## Top guides

- [How to read a seat map](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/how-to-read-a-seat-map/): Plain English guide to aisles, exit rows, bulkheads and cabin codes on a seat map.
- [Seat map glossary](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/seat-map-glossary/): Definitions of exit row, bulkhead, pitch, layout and other cabin terms.
- [Aisle vs window](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/aisle-vs-window/): How to choose between aisle and window seats for rest, access and views.
- [Exit row tips](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/exit-row-tips/): What exit row seats usually mean for space, rules and storage, and who should skip them.
- [Bulkhead seats](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/bulkhead-seats/): Pros and cons of first row cabin seats, including bassinet notes and foot space.
- [Cabin class primer](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/cabin-class-primer/): What economy, premium economy, business and first usually change.
- [Red eye seat strategy](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/red-eye-seat-strategy/): Picking a seat on a shorter overnight flight for sleep, noise and a quick exit.
- [Connecting flight seat strategy](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/connecting-flight-seat-strategy/): Choosing seats that help you deplane quickly for a tight connection.
- [Bassinet and bulkhead seats with a baby](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/bassinet-bulkhead-seats/): Where bassinets usually attach and how to plan seats with an infant.
- [How to verify your aircraft type](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/how-to-verify-your-aircraft-type/): Confirming the jet on your ticket and spotting equipment swaps.
- [When to select your seats](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/when-to-select-your-seats/): How seat selection windows work from purchase through check in.
- [How Pick Your Row scores work](https://pickyourrow.com/guides/how-pickyourrow-scores-work/): What the 1 to 10 editorial seat scores and tags mean.
